# ui::Renderer

Header: `winui/render/Renderer.hpp`.

The drawing surface every [Element::render()](../tree/element.md#render) draws through.

A control calls it from render_override(). The library implements it twice: one renderer draws the window on screen, and TestRenderer records each call as a [RenderCommand](namespace-ui.md#rendercommand) for unit tests and [describe()](namespace-ui.md#describe). All coordinates are DIPs in window space. Every push_* must be balanced by its pop_* within the same render() call.

Example: 
```cpp
class SwatchControl final : public ui::Element
{
    ui::Color   color_ = ui::colors::White;
    std::string label_ = "White";

    // ... measure_override() ...
    void render_override(ui::Renderer& r, const ui::RenderContext& context) const override
    {
        const ui::Theme& theme = context.theme;
        r.fill_rounded_rect(bounds(), theme.corner_radius, color_);
        r.stroke_rounded_rect(bounds(), theme.corner_radius, theme.colors().text, 1.0f);

        // Clip and transform calls come in pairs around what they apply to; the scopes
        // (ui::ClipScope, ...) pop at the end of the block.
        r.push_clip(bounds());
        r.draw_text(label_, bounds(), theme.colors().text, theme.type.body);
        r.pop_clip();
    }
};
```

## ~Renderer

```cpp
virtual ~Renderer() = default
```

## fill_rounded_rect

```cpp
virtual void fill_rounded_rect(const Rect& bounds, float radius, const Color& color) = 0
```

Fills a rect with rounded corners (`radius` in DIPs, 0 for square) in a solid color.

## stroke_rounded_rect

```cpp
virtual void stroke_rounded_rect(const Rect& bounds, float radius, const Color& color, float stroke_width) = 0
```

Strokes a rounded rect's outline, the pen centered on `bounds`' edge.

## draw_text

```cpp
virtual void draw_text(std::string_view text, const Rect& bounds, const Color& color, const TextStyle& style) = 0
```

Draws UTF-8 `text` laid out in `bounds` per `style` (font, alignment, wrapping). [Text](../controls/text.md#uitext) overflowing `bounds` is not trimmed, and not clipped unless a clip is pushed.

## fill_rounded_rect_gradient

```cpp
virtual void fill_rounded_rect_gradient(const Rect& bounds, float radius, const LinearGradientBrush& brush) = 0
```

Fills a rounded rect with a gradient along the brush's axis. The XP and Vista themes draw their chrome with it.

## stroke_rounded_rect_gradient

```cpp
virtual void stroke_rounded_rect_gradient(const Rect& bounds, float radius, const LinearGradientBrush& brush, float extent_px, float stroke_width) = 0
```

Strokes a rounded rect with a gradient spanning `extent_px` device pixels, for Fluent's elevation border. [StrokeRoundedRectGradient](render-commands.md#struct-strokeroundedrectgradient) explains the sign of `extent_px`.

## stroke_line

```cpp
virtual void stroke_line(Point from, Point to, const Color& color, float stroke_width) = 0
```

A straight line; also one edge of a classic raised/sunken bevel (see [draw_bevel_border()](namespace-ui.md#draw_bevel_border), which draws a whole border out of these).

## stroke_wavy_line

```cpp
virtual void stroke_wavy_line(Point from, Point to, const Color& color, float stroke_width, float amplitude, float wavelength) = 0
```

Draws the misspelling squiggle (see [StrokeWavyLine](render-commands.md#struct-strokewavyline)).

## fill_polygon

```cpp
virtual void fill_polygon(const FillPolygon& polygon) = 0
```

Fills a closed polygon with one color (see [FillPolygon](render-commands.md#struct-fillpolygon)).

## stroke_polyline

```cpp
virtual void stroke_polyline(const StrokePolyline& polyline) = 0
```

Strokes straight lines through a list of points (see [StrokePolyline](render-commands.md#struct-strokepolyline)).

## draw_geometry

```cpp
virtual void draw_geometry(const DrawGeometry& geometry) = 0
```

Fills and strokes a [PathGeometry](path-geometry.md) (see [DrawGeometry](render-commands.md#struct-drawgeometry)). A backend that cannot draw an [AcrylicBrush](acrylic-brush.md) draws its fallback color.

## push_clip

```cpp
virtual void push_clip(const Rect& bounds) = 0
```

Clips everything drawn until the matching [pop_clip()](#pop_clip) to `bounds`, intersected with any enclosing clip.

## pop_clip

```cpp
virtual void pop_clip() = 0
```

Ends the innermost [push_clip()](#push_clip), [push_clip_ellipse()](#push_clip_ellipse) or [push_clip_rounded_rect()](#push_clip_rounded_rect).

## push_clip_ellipse

```cpp
virtual void push_clip_ellipse(Point center, float radius_x, float radius_y) = 0
```

An elliptical clip, ended by the same [pop_clip()](#pop_clip) as a rect clip (see [PushClipEllipse](render-commands.md#struct-pushclipellipse)).

## push_clip_rounded_rect

```cpp
virtual void push_clip_rounded_rect(const Rect& bounds, float radius) = 0
```

A clip to `bounds` with corners rounded by `radius`, ended by the same [pop_clip()](#pop_clip) (see [PushClipRoundedRect](push-clip-rounded-rect.md)). A radius of 0 is the same clip as [push_clip()](#push_clip).

## fill_ellipse

```cpp
virtual void fill_ellipse(Point center, float radius_x, float radius_y, const Color& color) = 0
```

Fills an ellipse centered on `center`, radii in DIPs.

## stroke_ellipse

```cpp
virtual void stroke_ellipse(Point center, float radius_x, float radius_y, const Color& color, float stroke_width) = 0
```

Strokes an ellipse outline centered on `center`, radii in DIPs.

## fill_rect_pattern

```cpp
virtual void fill_rect_pattern(const Rect& bounds, Pattern pattern, const Color& fg, const Color& bg) = 0
```

Fills `bounds` with a two-color stipple (see [Pattern](namespace-ui.md#pattern)).

## draw_image_nine_slice

```cpp
virtual void draw_image_nine_slice(const std::string& image_name, const Rect& bounds, const Thickness& slice_margins)
```

Optional image-theme chrome (see ImageThemePack). A no-op wherever `image_name` isn't found in whatever pack the backend was configured with; ImageThemePack::empty() is the common case, and every backend must tolerate it. The default draws nothing, which is what a backend with no pack does.

## draw_image

```cpp
virtual void draw_image(const Bitmap& image, const Rect& bounds, Stretch stretch) = 0
```

A caller-supplied bitmap, stretched into `bounds` per `stretch` (see [DrawImage](render-commands.md#struct-drawimage)). `image` need only be valid for the duration of the call.

## draw_image_rect

```cpp
virtual void draw_image_rect(const Bitmap& image, const Rect& source, const Rect& bounds) = 0
```

Draws the `source` part of `image` into `bounds` (see [DrawImageRect](render-commands.md#struct-drawimagerect)). `source` is in the image's pixels and is clipped to them.

## draw_svg

```cpp
virtual void draw_svg(const SvgImage& svg, const Rect& bounds) = 0
```

Draws `svg` into `bounds` (see [DrawSvg](render-commands.md#struct-drawsvg)). A backend that cannot draw SVG draws nothing.

## push_opacity_layer

```cpp
virtual void push_opacity_layer(float opacity) = 0
```

Draws everything until the matching [pop_opacity_layer()](#pop_opacity_layer) as one layer at `opacity` (0..1); see [PushOpacityLayer](render-commands.md#struct-pushopacitylayer).

## pop_opacity_layer

```cpp
virtual void pop_opacity_layer() = 0
```

Ends the innermost [push_opacity_layer()](#push_opacity_layer).

## push_matrix

```cpp
virtual void push_matrix(const Matrix& transform) = 0
```

Transforms everything drawn until the matching [pop_transform()](#pop_transform); nested pushes compose, the inner one applying first (see [PushTransform](render-commands.md#struct-pushtransform)). What every [push_transform()](#push_transform) overload lands in: a backend implements this one, and callers use [push_transform()](#push_transform).

## push_transform

```cpp
void push_transform(const Matrix& transform)
```

Transforms everything drawn until the matching [pop_transform()](#pop_transform) by `transform`; see [push_matrix()](#push_matrix).

## push_transform

```cpp
void push_transform(float scale_x, float scale_y, Point offset)
```

Scale by `scale_x`/`scale_y` about the origin, then translate by `offset`.

## push_transform

```cpp
void push_transform(float scale, Point offset)
```

Uniform scale by `scale`, then translate by `offset`.

## pop_transform

```cpp
virtual void pop_transform() = 0
```

Ends the innermost [push_transform()](#push_transform).

## set_rasterization

```cpp
virtual void set_rasterization(const SetRasterization& policy) = 0
```

Sets the theme's rasterization policy (see [SetRasterization](render-commands.md#struct-setrasterization)). [Window::render()](../tree/window.md#render) calls it once per frame, first, from the active [Theme](../themes/theme.md). A backend that ignores it draws everything antialiased, which matches the Modern look.

## device_scale

```cpp
virtual float device_scale() const
```

Device pixels per DIP on the target, the DPI over 96: 1 unless the backend knows better. Everything else stays in DIPs; this is for the few classic marks that are drawn pixel by pixel, like the radio well ([draw_classic_radio()](namespace-ui.md#draw_classic_radio)) and the solid arrows ([draw_classic_arrow()](namespace-ui.md#draw_classic_arrow)), which pick a mask per device size instead of scaling a 100 % one.
